title: DeBank Portfolio Snapshot Net Worth Leaderboard
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=debank:portfolio net_worth_usd=*
| stats sum(net_worth_usd) as total_value, avg(net_worth_usd) as avg_value by chain
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks chain values by total and average net worth across DeBank portfolio snapshot events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `net_worth_usd` values for each DeBank portfolio snapshot event and review total and average net worth by chain.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total net worth.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly keeps which chain shows the biggest net worth numbers in your DeBank portfolio snapshot data.
